title: Flash dump
summary: Open a flash dump and page through it as hex, view the selected definition's maps as a heat grid, verify its checksums and edit map cells. Saving asks first, archives the old file in the vault and corrects the checksums; Fix & save writes a new file.
steps: Open a dump (Ctrl+O, or drop it on the window)
Pick the matching definition and check the checksum status
Edit cells, then Save: confirm, vault backup, checksums corrected

title: Analyze bin
summary: Work out ECU family, identity strings, catalog and definition matches, checksum status and known maps from a raw dump, with a graded confidence. Early alpha.
steps: Choose a .bin file
Read the family, identity strings and matches
Open a match in Identify or Maps

title: Maps
summary: Every map of every ECU definition, searchable, with its address, storage, scaling, axes and bounds, and a live heat-grid preview when the open dump holds it. Picking one opens it in the Flash dump view.
steps: Search by name, address or definition
Read the map's scaling, axes and bounds
Open it in the Flash dump view to edit

title: Compare
summary: Decode every map of a definition from two images and show per map how many cells changed and by how much, in physical units.
steps: Choose a stock and a tuned image
Pick the definition both share
Read changed cells per map in real units

title: Project
summary: Save the dump reference (path + fingerprint), its definition, checksum algorithm and notes as a small .otproj file, and reopen them together later. Same format as the desktop app; it never holds a copy of the image.
steps: Open a dump and pick its definition
Save the .otproj next to the image
Reopen it to continue later

title: Vault
summary: The full-image backups OpenTune saves before every write, with their .meta sidecars and a CRC-32 re-check. Nothing here changes a backup: open it read-only, reveal it in the file manager, or copy it to a new file.
steps: Open a dump, or choose the backup folder
Check each backup's CRC-32
Copy the .bin you need to a new file

title: Drive view
summary: Big, high-contrast tiles readable at arm's length: RPM, speed, coolant, intake air, boost and load (plus GPS speed and speed error when present) with min/max/peak hold, a 60 s sparkline and warn/critical colouring. A tile that is not fresh says so (stale, no data, link lost) instead of showing a frozen number. Replay plays any log the Log viewer opens at 1×–8× with a scrub bar, offline. Live mode (Bench builds) shows the Dashboard's polling.
steps: Replay: Open log… (or ▶ Drive view in the Log viewer), then play at 1×–8×
Live (Bench): Start, or keep the Dashboard / a Live log session running
F fullscreen, R reset min/max, Space pause

title: Log viewer
summary: Open a CSV datalog, plot and zoom its channels, and overlay it on a map to see which cells were used, for how long and with which values, then Open in Maps to edit that map. Units are compared, never converted.
needs: Definition + image for the map overlay
steps: Open a CSV log and tick channels to plot
Zoom with the wheel, drag to pan, read values at the cursor
Map overlay: definition, map, image, X/Y channels → Overlay

title: Dashboard
summary: Live gauges over OBD-II mode 01 (RPM, load, temperatures, boost, MAF, EGT, rail pressure, battery). Only values the ECU supports are shown. Record writes the polled values to a Live-log CSV for the Log viewer. Optional GPS card: an NMEA receiver (or recorded file) adds position, GPS speed and the speedometer error.
steps: Detect the adapter, engine running
Pick a preset or your own values
Start: only values the ECU reports are shown

title: Inspection
summary: Emissions-inspection data over generic OBD-II: check-engine lamp, readiness monitors, stored / pending / permanent codes, freeze frame, and calibration IDs with their verification numbers (CVN). One module or every OBD module.
steps: Detect the adapter, ignition on
Read all (tick All OBD modules for every ECU)
Check MIL, monitors not ready, codes and CVNs

title: Live log
summary: Stream ECU values from a RomRaider-style logger.xml or a pack's logger JSON (e.g. the bundled generic OBD-II mode-01 set) into a live table and save them as CSV. UDS 0x22 DIDs, OBD-II mode-01 PIDs and 0x23 memory reads are driven; identification DIDs marked as text/BCD/hex show their decoded text. Fast (0x2C) mode packs the channels into dynamically defined DIDs (one request per sample) and falls back to polling with the reason. Subaru SSM over K-line or CAN (ECU or TCU, or a simulated module offline) identifies the module and lists the parameters it leaves out. Reconnect (opt-in) re-opens the adapter after a dropped link; link events go into the CSV. Optional GPS card: an NMEA receiver (or recorded file) adds gps_* channels and the vehicle-vs-GPS speed error to the CSV.
steps: Load a logger definition
Pick parameters and Start
Save the log as CSV

title: Auto-scan
summary: Probe every module in a vehicle's module list for presence, identity and stored fault codes. Scanning is read-only; Clear all DTCs writes.
steps: Detect the adapter (HS/MS switch on the module bus)
Choose the vehicle's module list and Scan
Clear codes per module only after fixing the cause

title: Coding
summary: Read and decode a module's coding, preview a change as a dry run, and write it with a backup and read-back verify.
steps: Load a coding definition and set the target module
Read, change a value, preview the diff
Confirm and Write: backup first, read-back verify after

title: Adaptation
summary: Read adaptation values, run basic-settings routines and actuator tests from an adaptation definition (UDS, or VAG KWP2000 over TP2.0 / K-line). Tests move real parts.
steps: Load an adaptation definition and set the target
Read channels before changing anything
Routines and tests ask for confirmation

title: Actuator tests
summary: Drive one declared output (fan, lamp, solenoid) for a set time with UDS 0x2F, inside its declared range and time limit. Control returns to the ECU at the end, on STOP and on any error. Moves real parts.
steps: Load an adaptation definition with actuator channels
Pick an output, a value and a time inside its limits
Confirm: the output runs, then control returns to the ECU

title: Service functions
summary: Plan (send nothing) or run a ServiceScript procedure such as DPF regeneration, service reset, SAS calibration or EPB service mode.
steps: Load a service script
Plan shows every step without sending
Run only with the car stationary and charged

title: Haldex AWD
summary: OpenHaldex controller status (lock, slip) and drive mode over its UDS DIDs on 0x70F/0x779, a read-only Haldex Gen4 read (refused on real hardware until a driver opens VW TP2.0; simulated unit available), and an offline decoder for drivetrain-CAN captures with lock, clutch and temperature charts.
needs: Adapter: CAN (drivetrain CAN on PQ cars)
OpenHaldex unit, or a CAN log
steps: Tick Simulated unit to try it, or connect to the drivetrain CAN
Read status; change the mode only when stationary (confirm + read-back)
Decode a CAN capture offline: lock, clutch and temperature charts

title: CAN capture
summary: Capture all CAN bus traffic to a candump log, CSV or Vector ASC file with a live per-ID table. Listen-only where the adapter supports it.
steps: Detect a CAN-capable adapter on the right bus
Choose format and file, then Start
Stop to close the file; watch Dropped

title: Aftermarket ECU
summary: Speeduino, rusEFI and MegaSquirt through their TunerStudio INI: load and edit tunes (.msq) offline with the INI's limits, then connect over serial (or the simulated ECU), check the signature, read, plan a write, and write with a backup first, read-back verify and an optional burn. Live channel tiles.
needs: USB serial to the ECU (or sim)
Engine off, ignition on, stable supply for writes
steps: Load the INI for the ECU's firmware (and a .msq, or read the ECU)
Edit tables and settings: values outside the INI's limits are refused
Connect (port or sim), Plan write, then Write: backup first, verify, burn

title: Check my car
summary: A guided, read-only check for anyone: connect the adapter, read the VIN, scan for trouble codes and readiness, get them explained in plain words, take a short live snapshot and save or print a report. Nothing is written and no codes are cleared.
needs: Adapter: CAN (or the virtual car / OBD simulator)
Engine idling for the live check
steps: Plug in the adapter, ignition on, then Check the adapter
Run each step in turn: skip or retry any of them
Save or print the report at the end

title: ECU database
summary: Searchable reference of ECUs, TCUs and AWD units: CPU, flash size, how to read them, checksum family, vehicles and bench pinouts with a confidence level.
steps: Search by name, part number or car
Open a unit for read methods and checksum
Check the pinout confidence before wiring a bench

title: Drivers
summary: The interface drivers in this build and what each can do. Pick one in the top bar's cable list.
steps: Find your cable in the list
Check what it can do (CAN, K-line, flash)
Pick it in the top bar's cable list

title: Controllers
summary: Drivetrain controller definitions (gearbox TCUs, AWD couplings) from the built-in set and from definition packs: identity, diagnostics, CAN frame sets and signals, live channels, tables, gear ratios, safety notes, sources and validation state. Decodes a CAN log offline with a definition's frame sets.
needs: A CAN log (candump, CSV or Vector ASC) to decode
steps: Search by name, maker or protocol
Read the safety notes first
Decode a CAN log offline with a definition's frame sets

title: Utilities
summary: Offline VIN, part-number and DTC decoders, and a calculator for generic (non-OEM) seed/key transforms.
steps: Type a VIN, part number or fault code
Read the decoded fields
Seed/key: pick a generic transform and enter a seed

title: SA2 script
summary: Run your own VAG SA2 seed/key script offline: paste it, load a file or pick it from your own FRF / ODX / SGO container, read the disassembly and lints, and compute the key for a seed. OpenTune ships no script.
needs: Your own SA2 script or flash container
steps: Paste a script, load a file, or open your own container and pick a candidate
Read the disassembly and lints
Enter a seed you know the key for and Compute key

title: Guide
summary: This offline guide: general pages and one page per panel.
steps: Pick a page in the list
Read the panel's page
Use the panel help for a short version

title: Debug
summary: Read-only raw diagnostic requests to the app's target module, the offline UDS simulator, a guided auto-debug self-test and the session log. Requests that would change the ECU are refused unsent; ECU changes go through the module panels' confirmation and backup. Alpha builds only.
steps: Connect the adapter and check the target module (Adapter settings)
Send a read request, or try it on the simulator first
Copy or save the session log for analysis

title: About & updates
summary: The installed version, the highlights of this version and a Check for updates button that opens the OpenTune releases page in your browser. The app never downloads or installs anything itself.
needs: Internet (only to view the releases page)
steps: Open About from the help or settings menu
Read What's new for this version
Check for updates opens the releases page
